name: Langfuse
description: Open-source LLM observability and evaluation, acquired by ClickHouse in 2026.
descriptionZh: 开源 LLM 可观测与评测平台，2026 年被 ClickHouse 收购。
keyFact: Langfuse is an open-core LLM observability and evaluation platform whose repository is MIT-licensed except for the ee/ directory; ClickHouse acquired it in January 2026 and committed to keeping the MIT product open, with Cloud and self-hosted running the same codebase on ClickHouse.
keyFactZh: Langfuse 是 open-core 的 LLM 可观测与评测平台，除 ee/ 目录外整仓为 MIT 许可；ClickHouse 于 2026 年 1 月将其收购，并承诺 MIT 产品继续开源，Cloud 与自托管运行同一套基于 ClickHouse 的代码库。
caveat: Enterprise features (RBAC, audit logs) live in the separately licensed ee/ directory.
caveatZh: 企业功能（RBAC、审计日志）位于单独授权许可的 ee/ 目录。
